description: This file contains unit tests for the CommandParser class used in the modem simulator component of the project. It tests various parsing methods such as skipping prefixes, commas, whitespace, and extracting strings, integers, and hexadecimal values from command strings.

methods.name: SkipPrefix
methods.description: Tests the SkipPrefix method of CommandParser to ensure it correctly skips the prefix in a command string.

methods.name: SkipPrefixAT
methods.description: Tests the SkipPrefixAT method to verify it correctly skips the 'AT' prefix.

methods.name: SkipComma
methods.description: Tests the SkipComma method to ensure it skips over comma-separated values.

methods.name: SkipWhiteSpace
methods.description: Tests the SkipWhiteSpace method to verify it skips whitespace characters.

methods.name: GetNextStr_default
methods.description: Tests the GetNextStr method to extract the next string token from the command.

methods.name: GetNextStr_withparam
methods.description: Tests GetNextStr with different delimiters to extract parts of the command string.

methods.name: GetNextInt
methods.description: Tests extracting integer values from command strings.

methods.name: GetNextHexInt
methods.description: Tests converting hexadecimal string segments to decimal integers.

methods.name: GetNextStrDeciToHex
methods.description: Tests converting decimal string segments to hexadecimal string representations.
